identityTradability.exchangeName: Planet Labs PBC Class A Common Stock

discovery-weak-signals.name: earth-intelligence demand
discovery-weak-signals.basis: record revenue, recurring contract mix and backlog support expanding demand

expectations-execution.name: execution and operating leverage
expectations-execution.basis: record growth accompanied by positive adjusted EBITDA and free-cash-flow measures

thesisQuality.basis: Filed growth plus backlog/recurring-demand evidence demonstrate adoption, offset by losses and hardware mix.

financialOperatingMomentum.basis: Strong revenue growth, positive YTD operating/free cash flow and liquidity are constrained by capex and dilution.

marketValuationOpportunity.basis: Valuation remains demanding relative to trailing revenue despite growth.

catalystScore.basis: Berlin manufacturing, Isar deployment and backlog conversion are identifiable catalysts with execution risk.

governancePower.basis: Capacity execution is credible but ATM issuance, losses and capital intensity keep stewardship mixed.

alignment2036.basis: Earth observation and sovereign geospatial intelligence serve durable infrastructure/security needs.

crossDivisionLeverage.basis: Shared satellite/data capability spans government, defense and commercial uses.

bottleneckControl.basis: Owned constellation and expanded manufacturing capacity create meaningful capability control though substitutes exist.

scenarioRobustness.basis: Commercial and sovereign paths diversify demand, but capital intensity and defense concentration constrain robustness.

substitutionResilience.basis: Owned high-cadence imagery infrastructure creates moderate barriers while alternatives remain credible.

supplyChainResilience.basis: Berlin adds geographic capacity and Isar a named launch path, but realized redundancy and reliability remain unproven.

pricingPower.basis: Recurring demand supports moderate value capture; concentration, hardware mix and substitutes limit demonstrated scarcity rent.

riskEvidence.basis: Capital intensity, dilution, concentration, substitution, valuation and execution risks are partly offset by liquidity and demand visibility.

dataConfidenceEvidence.basis: Current SEC financials plus issuer operating evidence, same-day independent reporting and market data support scoring; long-run unit economics remain undisclosed.

scoreRecord.thesis: Scaled Earth-observation infrastructure plus sovereign demand and added manufacturing/deployment capacity support durable relevance, while valuation, capital intensity and concentration constrain asymmetry.
scoreRecord.keyRisk: Backlog and capacity must convert into durable GAAP economics without excessive dilution.
scoreRecord.nextCatalyst: Next-quarter execution, Berlin-built Pelican production and Isar launch execution.
